text: Swannies (Swannies Golf Apparel) is a Twin Cities golf-apparel company founded in 2015 by Matt Stang and Adam Iversen; the co-founders still lead the business and are building a management layer to transition decision-making away from themselves.
short: Swannies is a golf-apparel company founded and still led by co-founders Matt Stang and Adam Iversen.

source.name: gener8tor Founder Series: Matt Stang from Swannies
source.quote: Founded in 2015 by Matt Stang and his co-founder Adam Iversen, Swannies began as a passion project for two friends who saw an opportunity to modernize golf apparel.
source.note: Page shows only 'Jul 3' without a year (site footer says 2026); opened 2026-10-03. The article also describes transitioning decision-making authority away from the founders.
